item.title: Energy costs surge amid Iran war, hitting consumers and transport firms
item.description: Diesel prices surged to an all-time high of about $6.31 a gallon on Wednesday, up more than 70% from a year ago, as the U.S. war with Iran continues to disrupt global energy supplies, according to AAA. The spike is pinching transportation companies and adding an estimated $1,760 in costs per U.S.…

item.title: U.S. measles deaths reach highest level in decades as local officials step in amid federal inaction
item.description: Pennsylvania reported two more measles-related deaths yesterday, bringing the total number of U.S. measles deaths this year to four—the highest annual tally since 1992.
